name: PixelProse
description: Training large vision-language models requires extensive, high-quality image-text pairs. Existing web-scraped datasets, however, are noisy and lack detailed image descriptions. To bridge this gap, we introduce PixelProse, a comprehensive dataset of over 16M (million) synthetically generated captions, leveraging cutting-edge vision-language models for detailed and accurate descriptions. To ensure data integrity, we rigorously analyze our dataset for problematic content, including child sexual abuse material (CSAM), personally identifiable information (PII), and toxicity. We also provide valuable metadata such as watermark presence and aesthetic scores, aiding in further dataset filtering. We hope PixelProse will be a valuable resource for future vision-language research. PixelProse is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/tomg-group-umd/pixelprose
general_score_metric: Human preference / CLIPScore (and other retrieval/captioning metrics when applicable)
reputation: A large synthetic caption dataset that is mainly used as a data resource rather than a widely adopted standalone benchmark.
notes: Primarily a training dataset, not a standard model-evaluation benchmark; useful for captioning and data curation research, with metadata for safety and quality filtering.
